title: Arena Chess
tagline: Classical chess on a marble board, against an AI that grows with you.
description: The complete Laws of Chess — castling, en passant, promotion, check, checkmate and stalemate, the fifty- and seventy-five-move rules, threefold and fivefold repetition, insufficient material — on Poly Haven's marble Staunton set. The AI opponent searches with alpha-beta, a transposition table and quiescence, from a forgiving level 1 to a club-strength level 5. Take back, offer or claim a draw, resign, play with a clock, and keep the PGN.
scoring: 100 points for a win, 40 for a draw, 10 for a loss, times the AI level; take-backs cost 15 each. Rated games move an Elo rating against the level's rating (level 1 = 800 … level 5 = 1800).
controls: Tap or click a piece, then its square
Right-drag or two-finger drag to turn the board, scroll or pinch to zoom
